description: Fuzzy name matcher (people and companies) — Score how well a name matches one or many candidates, offline. a= the name, b= a candidate or up to 50 separated by |; optional type=person|company|auto and threshold= (default 0.88). Folds accents, removes titles and legal suffixes (Inc, LLC, GmbH, plc...), handles Last, First order, nicknames (Bill=William, Bob=Robert, Mohammed=Muhammad...), initials and sound-alike spellings (Soundex), and caps person scores when the family name differs. Returns a 0-1 score, MATCH / POSSIBLE MATCH / NO MATCH per candidate, ranked, with the token alignment and notes. Good for KYC/AML hit triage, CRM de-duplication and vendor matching (pair with /v1/legal/sanctions-screen). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_name_match
